operating_notes.text: Acquired second tranche of Mother Sparsh for ~₹30 Cr, taking holding to 49.32%.
Digital-first and organic portfolios crossed an Annual Revenue Run Rate (ARR) of over ₹1,350 Cr in FY26.
Proposed medium-term capex of ₹20,000 crore for the Group.
Sproutlife Foods Private Limited became a subsidiary of the Company with effect from 1st April, 2026.
Completed the acquisition of Century Pulp and Paper business from Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited on a slump sale basis.
ITC Infotech approved acquisition of 22.1% stake in Happiest Minds Technologies for ₹1,330 Cr, to be followed by amalgamation and listing of ITC Infotech.
Blazeclan Technologies and Cloudlytics Technologies amalgamated into ITC Infotech and dissolved without winding up.
Acquired remaining 52.5% stake in Sproutlife Foods Private Limited for ~₹645 Cr, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.

timeline.summary: ITC received NCLT sanction for the amalgamation of Sresta Natural Bioproducts and Wimco with an effective date of 1st June, 2026.
ITC acquired the second tranche of shares in Mother Sparsh for ~₹30 Cr, increasing its stake to 49.32%.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹23,821.48 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹5,387.97 Cr.
ITC Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹8 per equity share for FY2026, payable between July 24–29, 2026, subject to AGM approval on July 23, 2026.
ITC reported Q4 FY26 standalone gross revenue of ₹21,463 Cr (up 17.5% YoY) and PAT of ₹5,113 Cr (up 4.9% YoY), while recommending a final dividend of ₹8 per share.
ITC Limited’s 115th AGM held on July 23, 2026, chaired by **S. Puri**, passed all resolutions with requisite majority.
ITC Limited held its 115th AGM on July 23, 2026, where the Chairman announced a ₹20,000 crore medium-term group capex plan.
On July 23, 2026, Crisil assigned ITC a Core ESG rating of 76 and an overall ESG Score of 69 under the Strong category for FY2025-26.
ITC received an ESG score of 67 (Strong) for FY25-26 from ESG Risk Assessments & Insights Limited, down 1 point YoY.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹29,523.3 Cr (+27.6% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4,394.13 Cr (-16.2% YoY).
ITC completed the acquisition of the pulp and paper business of Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited under the name Century Pulp and Paper.
ITC announced a strategic combination where its subsidiary ITC Infotech will acquire a 22.1% stake in Happiest Minds Technologies for ₹1,330 Cr, followed by an amalgamation to list ITC Infotech.
ITC completed the amalgamation of step-down units Blazeclan Technologies and Cloudlytics Technologies into ITC Infotech.
ITC acquired the remaining stake in Sproutlife Foods Private Limited for ~₹645 Cr; making it a 100% subsidiary.
